<parameter=content>
It's wonderful how every teen movie has taught us that high school is full of spontaneous musical numbers and that every problem can be solved with a good dance-off. Truly, life's complexities distilled into a perfectly choreographed battle of the bands, because why confront issues when you can simply out-dance them?
